quotes.quote: Learning and innovation go hand in hand. The arrogance of success is to think that what you did yesterday will be sufficient for tomorrow.

quotes.quote: My main hope is eventually, in modern education field, introduce education about warm-heartedness, not based on religion, but based on common experience and a common sort of sense, and then scientific finding.

quotes.quote: Often, it's not about becoming a new person, but becoming the person you were meant to be, and already are, but don't know how to be.

quotes.author: Dylan Thomas

quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.quote: There is nothing more unequal than the equal treatment of unequal people.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

To be able to be caught up into the world of thought--that is to be educated."[Saturday Evening Post, September 27, 1958]
quotes.author: Edith Hamilton

quotes.quote: School is the advertising agency which makes you believe that you need the society as it is.
quotes.author: Ivan Illich

quotes.quote: By 20, you should be smart. By 30, you should be strong. By 40, you should be rich. By 50, you should be wise. But if you are smart, strong, rich and wise, you don't need any age limits.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.quote: Public education was not founded to give society what it wants. Quite the opposite.
quotes.author: May Sarton

quotes.author: Wilhelm Reich

quotes.quote: Let us pick up our books and our pens,' I said. 'They are our most powerful weapons. One child, one teacher, one book and one pen can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai,  I Am Malala: The Girl Who Stood Up for Education and Was Shot by the Taliban

quotes.quote: What does education often do? It makes a straight-cut ditch of a free, meandering brook.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: One cannot expect positive results from an educational or political action program which fails to respect the particular view of the world held by the people. Such a program constitutes cultural invasion, good intentions notwithstanding.
quotes.author: Paulo Freire,  Pedagogy of the Oppressed

quotes.quote: The job of an educator is to teach students to see vitality in themselves
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: You have learnt something. That always feels at first as if you have lost something.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw,  Major Barbara

quotes.quote: ....a good book can teach you about the world and about yourself. You learn more than how to read better; you also learn more about life. You become wiser. Not just more knowledgeable - books that provide nothing but information can produce that result. But wiser, in the sense that you are more deeply aware of the great and enduring truths of human life.
quotes.author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

quotes.quote: Education is a weapon, whose effect depends on who holds it in his hands and at whom it is aimed.
quotes.author: Joseph Stalin

quotes.quote: She got on with her education. In her opinion, school kept on trying to interfere with it.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Soul Music

quotes.quote: I am not the moon orbiting around your planet; I am the sun that will burn through your frozen mind.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Do you train for passing tests or do you train for creative inquiry?
quotes.author: Noam Chomsky

quotes.quote: Education...has produced a vast population able to read but unable to distinguish what is worth reading.
quotes.author: George Macaulay Trevelyan

quotes.quote: Rewards and punishment is the lowest form of education.
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.quote: When learning is purposeful, creativity blossoms. When creativity blossoms, thinking emanates. When thinking emanates, knowledge is fully lit. When knowledge is lit, economy flourishes.
quotes.author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam,  Indomitable Spirit

quotes.quote: [The public school system is] usually a twelve year sentence of mind control.Crushing creativity, smashing individualism, encouraging collectivism andcompromise, destroying the exercise of intellectual inquiry, twisting itinstead into meek subservience to authority.
quotes.author: Walter Karp

quotes.quote: I do not want the peace which passeth understanding, I want the understanding which bringeth peace.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: It is clearly absurd to limit the term 'education' to a person's formal schooling.
quotes.author: Murray N. Rothbard,  Education, Free & Compulsory

quotes.quote: Ah, child and youth, if you knew the bliss which resides in the taste of knowledge, and the evil and ugliness that lies in ignorance, how well you are advised to not complain of the pain and labor of learning.
quotes.author: Christine de Pizan,  The Treasure of the City of Ladies

quotes.quote: Everything can be explained to the people, on the single condition that you want them to understand.
quotes.author: Frantz Fanon,  The Wretched of the Earth

quotes.quote: The thing that's important to know is that you never know. You're always sort of feeling your way.
quotes.author: Diane Arbus,  Diane Arbus: Revelations

quotes.quote: Imagination is the source of every form of human achievement. And it's the one thing that I believe we are systematically jeopardizing in the way we educate our children and ourselves.
quotes.author: Ken Robinson

quotes.quote: The child intuitively comprehends that although these stories are unreal, they are not untrue ...
quotes.author: Bruno Bettelheim,  The Uses of Enchantment: The Meaning and Importance of Fairy Tales

quotes.quote: How is it that little children are so intelligent and men so stupid? It must be education that does it
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas

quotes.quote: The learning process is something you can incite, literally incite, like a riot.
quotes.author: Audre Lorde

quotes.quote: ... what you learn today, for no reason at all, will help you discover all the wonderful secrets of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Norton Juster,  The Phantom Tollbooth

quotes.quote: There is no wealth like knowledge, no poverty like ignorance.
quotes.author: Ali

quotes.quote: True education does not consist merely in the acquiring of a few facts of science, history, literature, or art, but in the development of character.
quotes.author: David O. McKay

quotes.quote: On ne naÃ®t pas femme: on le devient.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir,  Le deuxiÃ¨me sexe II

quotes.quote: I became convinced that noncooperation with evil is as much a moral obligation as is cooperation with good.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  The Autobiography of Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: You can present the material, but you can't make me care.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson,  Homicidal Psycho Jungle Cat

quotes.quote: Teachers are the one and only people who save nations.
quotes.author: Mustafa Kemal AtatÃ¼rk

quotes.quote: For so many years, I couldn't understand why every time I thought that someone finally loved me, like... for real, they would eventually turn to vapor. quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: University can teach you skill and give you opportunity, but it can't teach you sense, nor give you understanding. Sense and understanding are produced within one's soul.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: It's what we think we know that keeps us from learning.
quotes.author: Claude Bernard

quotes.quote: Proper teaching is recognized with ease. You can know it without fail because it awakens within you that sensation which tells you this is something you have always known.
quotes.author: Frank Herbert,  Dune

quotes.quote: That is the one eternal education: to be sure enough that something is true that you dare to tell it to a child.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: Education: that which reveals to the wise, and conceals from the stupid, the vast limits of their knowledge.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Most learning is not the result of instruction. It is rather the result of unhampered participation in a meaningful setting. Most people learn best by being "with it,"yet school makes them identify their personal, cognitive growth with elaborate planning and manipulation.
quotes.author: Ivan Illich,  Deschooling Society

quotes.quote: To know how to suggest is the art of teaching.
quotes.author: Henri-FrÃ©dÃ©ric Amiel

quotes.quote: The man of science has learned to believe in justification, not by faith, but by verification.
quotes.author: Thomas Henry Huxley,  Collected Essays Of Thomas Henry Huxley

quotes.quote: When you wish to instruct, be brief; that men's [children's] minds take in quickly what you say, learn its lesson, and retain it faithfully. Every word that is unnecessary only pours over the side of a brimming mind.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: The home is the first and most effective place to learn the lessons of life: truth, honor, virtue, self control, the value of education, honest work, and the purpose and privilege of life. Nothing can take the place of home in rearing and teaching children, and no other success can compensate for failure in the home.
quotes.author: David O. McKay

quotes.quote: Being a role model is the most powerful form of educating...too often fathers neglect it because they get so caught up in making a living they forget to make a life.
quotes.author: John Wooden,  Wooden: A Lifetime of Observations and Reflections On and Off the Court

quotes.quote: Education is the process of selling someone on books.
quotes.author: Douglas Wilson

quotes.quote: I couldn't claim that I was smarter than sixty-five other guys--but the average of sixty-five other guys, certainly!
quotes.author: Richard Feynman,  Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!: Adventures of a Curious Character

quotes.quote: Self-education is the only possible education; the rest is mere veneer laid on the surface of a child's nature.
quotes.author: Charlotte M. Mason

quotes.quote: It's a big theme in my life, learning about myself and being a better person. I'm a work in progress; I have revelations every day.
quotes.author: Rick Rubin

quotes.quote: I would rather entertain and hope that people learned something than educate people and hope they were entertained.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote: There will be no mass-based feminist movement as long as feminist ideas are understood only by a well-educated few.
quotes.author: bell hooks,  Feminist Theory: From Margin to Center

quotes.quote: Whenever you read a good book, somewhere in the world a door opens to allow in more light.
quotes.author: Vera Nazarian

quotes.quote: Theological formation is the gradual and often painful discovery of God's incomprehensibility. You can be competent in many things, but you cannot be competent in God.
quotes.author: Henri J.M. Nouwen

quotes.quote: To expect the unexpected shows a thoroughly modern intellect.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  An Ideal Husband

quotes.quote: School prepares you for the real world... which also bites.
quotes.author: Jim Benton

quotes.quote: Teachers have three loves: love of learning, love of learners, and the love of bringing the first two loves together.
quotes.author: Scott Hayden

quotes.quote: Children should be educated and instructed in the principles of freedom. Aristotle speaks plainly to this purpose, saying, 'that the institution of youth should be accommodated to that form of government under which they live; forasmuch as it makes exceedingly for the preservation of the present government, whatsoever it be.
quotes.author: John Adams,  A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America

quotes.quote: I expect that you must receive top marks at school, young lady."Madeleine smiled as she stirred her tea. "There are always rewards for those who state the obvious frequently and with conviction.
quotes.author: Scott Westerfeld,  Touching Darkness

quotes.quote: If anyone says that the best life of all is to sail the sea, and then adds that I must not sail upon a sea where shipwrecks are a common occurrence and there are often sudden storms that sweep the helmsman in an adverse direction, I conclude that this man, although he lauds navigation, really forbids me to launch my ship.
quotes.author: Seneca,  The Stoic Philosophy of Seneca: Essays and Letters

quotes.quote: The barrier during self-improvement is not so much that we hate learning, rather we hate being taught. To learn entails that the knowledge was achieved on one's own accord - it feels great - but to be taught often leaves a feeling of inferiority. Thus it takes a bit of determination and a lot of humility in order for one to fully develop.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I am always ready to learn although I do not always like being taught.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: You didn't need a college degree to become one of the people who knew what was really going on. If you paid attention, you could pick things up on your own.
quotes.author: Jeannette Walls,  The Glass Castle

quotes.quote: Give the pupils something to do, not something to learn; and the doing is of such a nature as to demand thinking; learning naturally results.
quotes.author: John Dewey

quotes.quote: I can do this... I can start over. I can save my own life and I'm never going to be alone as long as I have stars to wish on and people to still love.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: I was lucky enough to be fairly quick at understanding what was taught, but unlucky enough not to be really interested in it, so I always got my exams but never had the scholar's love of learning for its own sake.
quotes.author: Maeve Binchy

quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

quotes.quote: We are all butterflies. Earth is our chrysalis.
quotes.author: LeeAnn Taylor

quotes.quote: Those who trust us educate us.

quotes.quote: College is the best time of your life. When else are your parents going to spend several thousand dollars a year just for you to go to a strange town and get drunk every night?
quotes.author: David Wood

quotes.quote: Education is what survives when what has been learnt has been forgotten.

quotes.quote: We have sold ourselves into a fast food model of education, and it's impoverishing our spirit and our energies as much as fast food is depleting our physical bodies.

quotes.author: Hendrik Willem van Loon

quotes.quote: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.

quotes.author: Gary L. Francione

quotes.quote: Knowledge which is acquired under compulsion has no hold on the mind. Therefore do not use compulsion, but let early education be a sort of amusement; you will then be better able to discover the child's natural bent.

quotes.quote: Admission of ignorance is often the first step in our education.

quotes.quote: The function of a child is to live his/her own life, not the life that his/her anxious parents think he/she should live, nor a life according to the purpose of the educators who thinks they knows best

quotes.author: Ravi Zacharias

quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Segregation shaped me; education liberated me.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: With one day's reading a man may have the key in his hands.
quotes.author: Ezra Pound

quotes.quote: The older I grow, the more I am convinced that there is no education which one can get from books and costly apparatus that is equal to that which can be gotten from contact with great men and women.
quotes.author: Booker T. Washington

quotes.quote: Literature is the safe and traditional vehicle through which we learn about the world and pass on values from on generation to the next. Books save lives.
quotes.author: Laurie Anderson

quotes.quote: Science replaces private prejudice with public, verifiable evidence.
quotes.author: Richard Dawkins

quotes.quote: I made a cauldron of coffee, and I was thinking we could chug it and then teach each other how to dance by using the bottom of a floating canoe as a ballroom.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Even those who do not, or cannot, avail themselves of a scientific education, choose to benefit from the technology that is made possible by the scientific education of others.

quotes.quote: [Homeschooling]...recipe for genius: More of family and less of school, more of parents and less of peers, more creative freedom and less formal lessons.
quotes.author: Raymond S. Moore,  School Can Wait

quotes.quote: The home environment can undo a lot you try to do at school.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: Formal education teaches how to stand, but to see the rainbow you must come out and walk many steps on your own.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: The acquisition of knowledge is always of use to the intellect, because it may thus drive out useless things and retain the good. For nothing can be loved or hated unless it is first known.

quotes.quote: Educated men are so impressive!

quotes.author: Jessie B. Rittenhouse

quotes.quote: Mistakes are a part of being human. Precious life lessons that can only be learned the hard way. Unless it's a fatal mistake, which, at least, others can learn from.
quotes.author: Al Franken

quotes.author: Windhy Puspitadewi

quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.quote: part of the art of teaching is the ability to rearrange the world for students - to force them to see things in a new way. i've known too many stupid intellectuals to believe that education and wisdom come as a package deal along with facts, it's your perspective that counts - your ability to see differently, not just to see a lot.
quotes.author: Sunny Decker,  An Empty Spoon

quotes.quote: Even if it were true that evolution, or the teaching of evolution, encouraged immorality that would not imply that the theory of evolution was false.
quotes.author: Richard Dawkins,  The Greatest Show on Earth: The Evidence for Evolution

quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai,  I Am Malala: The Girl Who Stood Up for Education and Was Shot by the Taliban

quotes.quote: She had observed that the more education they got, the less they could do. Their father had gone to a one-room schoolhouse through the eighth grade and he could do anything.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor,  Everything That Rises Must Converge: Stories

quotes.quote: At the end of your lives you will not be judged by academic successes, the degrees or diplomas earned, the positions held, the material wealth acquired, or power and prestige, but rather on the basis of what you have become as persons and what you are in conduct and character.
quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter

quotes.quote: A capacity, and taste, for reading, gives access to whatever has already been discovered by others. It is the key, or one of the keys, to the already solved problems. And not only so. It gives a relish, and facility, for successfully pursuing the [yet] unsolved ones.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Were all instructors to realize that the quality of mental process, not the production of correct answers, is the measure of educative growth something hardly less than a revolution in teaching would be worked.
quotes.author: John Dewey,  Democracy and Education

quotes.quote: Teachers don't just teach; they can be vital personalities who help young people to mature, to understand the world, and to understand themselves. A good education consists of much more than useful facts and marketable skills.
quotes.author: Charles Platt

quotes.quote: Everyone who is educated today wants to sit at a comfortable desk under a fan and live in an air-conditioned house surrounded by a garden, coming and going in an American car as wide as the street. quotes.author: Tayeb Salih,  Season of Migration to the North

quotes.quote: The best book is not one that informs merely, but one that stirs the reader up to inform himself.
quotes.author: A.W. Tozer,  Man The Dwelling Place Of God

quotes.quote: To be changed by ideas was pure pleasure. But to learn ideas that ran counter to values and beliefs learned at home was to place oneself at risk, to enter the danger zone. quotes.author: bell hooks

quotes.quote: It's much easier on the emotions when one sees life as an experiment rather than a struggle for popularity.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: In the end, it is our defiance that redeems us. If wolves had a religion - if there was a religion of the wolf - that it is what it would tell us.
quotes.author: Mark Rowlands,  The Philosopher and the Wolf: Lessons from the Wild on Love, Death, and Happiness

quotes.quote: Wine can be a better teacher than ink, and banter is often better than books
quotes.author: Stephen Fry,  The Fry Chronicles

quotes.quote: Not all men (and especially the wisest) share the opinion that it is bad for women to be educated. But it is very true that many foolish men have claimed this because it displeased them that women knew more than they did.
quotes.author: Christine de Pizan,  The Book of the City of Ladies

quotes.quote: I look out into the water and up deep into the stars. I beg the sparkling lanterns of light to cure me of myself -- my past and the kaleidoscope of mistakes, failures and wrong turns that have stacked unbearable regret upon my shoulders.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: School has become the world religion of a modernized proletariat, and makes futile promises of salvation to the poor of the technological age.
quotes.author: Ivan Illich,  Deschooling Society

quotes.quote: The direction in which education starts a man will determine his future life
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: Students never appreciate their teachers while they are learning. It is only later, when they know more of the world, that they understand how indebted they are to those who instructed them. Good teachers expect no praise or love from the young. They wait for it, and in time, it comes.
quotes.author: Darren Shan,  Vampire Mountain

quotes.quote: The master of the garden is the one who waters it, trims the branches, plants the seeds, and pulls the weeds. If you merely stroll through the garden, you are but an acolyte.
quotes.author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

quotes.quote: Learning is not cumpulsory... neither is survival.
quotes.author: W. Edwards Deming

quotes.quote: We can best help children learn, not by deciding what we think they should learn and thinking of ingenious ways to teach it to them, but by making the world, as far as we can, accessible to them, paying serious attention to what they do, answering their questions -- if they have any -- and helping them explore the things they are most interested in.
quotes.author: John Holt

quotes.quote: The great aim of education is not knowledge but action.

quotes.quote: One learns from books and example only that certain things can be done. Actual learning requires that you do those things.
quotes.author: Frank Herbert,  Children of Dune

quotes.quote: ...the greatest service we can do to education today is to teach fewer subjects. No one has time to do more than a very few things well before he is twenty, and when we force a boy to be a mediocrity in a dozen subjects, we destroy his standards, perhaps for life.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  Surprised by Joy: The Shape of My Early Life

quotes.quote: Throwing herself into learning helped Miri ignore the painful chill of solitude around her.
quotes.author: Shannon Hale,  Princess Academy

quotes.quote: That's what education should be,"I said, "the art of orientation. Educators should devise the simplest and most effective methods of turning minds around. quotes.author: Plato,  The Republic

quotes.quote: Life is a balanced system of learning and evolution. Whether pleasure or pain; every situation in your life serves a purpose. It is up to us to recognize what that purpose could be.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: re-examine all you have been told in school or church or in any book, and dismiss whatever insults your own soul; and your very flesh shall be a great poem, and have the richest fluency, not only in its words, but in the silent lines of its lips and face, and between the lashes of your eyes, and in every motion and joint of your body.[From the preface to Leaves Grass]
quotes.author: Walt Whitman,  Leaves of Grass

quotes.quote: Intelligence and education that hasn't been tempered by human affection isn't worth a damn.
quotes.author: Daniel Keyes

quotes.quote: Art is a process, not a product.

quotes.quote: Why wait? So precious is this life--this gift--this temporary blindness. Burn and drown and embrace the false dark, then grasp the unthinkable height of resulting joy. For in the end, in the light of truth when the flesh is cast off, there is nothing but this.
quotes.author: Jennifer DeLucy

quotes.quote: It has been discovered that with a dull urban population, all formed under a mechanical system of State education, a suggestion or command, however senseless and unreasoned, will be obeyed if it be sufficiently repeated.
quotes.author: Hilaire Belloc,  An Essay on the Restoration of Property

quotes.quote: One of these grand defects, as I humbly conceive, is this, that children are habituated to learning without understanding.
quotes.author: Jonathan Edwards,  The Works of Jonathan Edwards, Vol. 16: Letters and Personal Writings

quotes.quote: The aim of education should be to teach us rather how to think, than what to think - rather to improve our minds, so as to enable us to think for ourselves, than to load the memory with the thoughts of other men.
quotes.author: James Beattie

quotes.quote: The home is the chief school of human virtues.
quotes.author: William Ellery Channing

quotes.quote: Someday, I hope that we will all be patriots of our planet and not just of our respective nations.
quotes.author: Zoe Weil,  Most Good, Least Harm: A Simple Principle for a Better World and Meaningful Life

quotes.quote: My mum and dad had worked incredibly hard to afford me an education.
quotes.author: Benedict Cumberbatch

quotes.quote: Children are notoriously curious about everything, everything except... the things people want them to know. It then remains for us to refrain from forcing any kind of knowledge upon them, and they will be curious about everything.
quotes.author: Floyd Dell

quotes.quote: Once you've decided that something's absolutely true, you've closed your mind on it, and a closed mind doesn't go anywhere. Question everything. That's what education's all about.
quotes.author: David Eddings,  Belgarath the Sorcerer

quotes.quote: It is a very grave mistake to think that the enjoyment of seeing and searching can be promoted by means of coercion and a sense of duty. quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Ethical veganism represents a commitment to nonviolence.

quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: Education is not confined to books, and the finest characters often graduate from no college, but make experience their master, and life their book. quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott,  Jo's Boys

quotes.quote: I urge you to examine in your own mind the assumptions which must lay behind using the police power to insist that once-sovereign spirits have no choice but to submit to being schooled by strangers.
quotes.author: John Taylor Gatto

quotes.quote: Science is an attempt, largely successful, to understand the world, to get a grip on things, to get hold of ourselves, to steer a safe course. Microbiology and meteorology now explain what only a few centuries ago was considered sufficient cause to burn women to death.

quotes.quote: The purpose of school should not be to prepare students for more school. We should be seeking to have fully engaged students now.

quotes.quote: What is the matter with universities is that the students are school children, whereas it is of the very essence of university education that they should be adults.

quotes.quote: Far from failing in its intended task, our educational system is in fact succeeding magnificently because its aim is to keep the American people thoughtless enough to go on supporting the system.

quotes.quote: If the emotions are free the intellect will look after itself

quotes.quote: Philosophy is the toil which can never tire persons engaged in it. All ways are strewn with roses, and the farther you go, the more enchanting objects appear before you and invite you on.

quotes.author: Gary L. Francione

quotes.quote: If it were customary to send little girls to school and teach them the same subjects as are taught to boys, they would learn just as fully and would understand the subtleties of all arts and sciences.

quotes.quote: The most effective kind of education is that a child should play amongst lovely things.

quotes.quote: A brick could be used to perpetually feed the hungry, stop all wars, educate the masses, and ensure everlasting peace for all populations throughout time. Wait, I'm sorry, that's not right. I was confusing a brick with a blanket. It's a blanket that could be used for all those things.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

quotes.quote: You can't learn everything you need to know legally.
quotes.author: John Irving,  A Widow for One Year

quotes.quote: Libraries allow children to ask questions about the world and find the answers. And the wonderful thing is that once a child learns to use a library, the doors to learning are always open.
quotes.author: Laura Bush

quotes.quote: ...Shouldn't schools be the place where students interact with interesting books? Shouldn't the faculty have an ongoing laser-like commitment to put good books in our students' hands? Shouldn't this be a front-burner issue at all times?

quotes.quote: No wonder so many adults long to return to university, to all those deadlines--ahhh, that structure! Scaffolding to which we may cling! Even if it is arbitrary, without it, we're lost, wholly incapable of separating the Romantic from the Victorian in our sad, bewildering lives...

quotes.quote: I'm a Prince of Wales Trust ambassador, so I'm all about giving youth an education, a voice and a chance to not take the wrong road.
quotes.author: Benedict Cumberbatch

quotes.quote: I read Shakespeare and the Bible, and I can shoot dice. That's what I call a liberal education.
quotes.author: Tallulah Bankhead

quotes.quote: People are afraid of being more ignorant than their childrenâ€•especially, apparantly, their daughters.

quotes.quote: Is he well educated?""Yes, I think so, as far as he's gone,"I answered. "Of course he will go on being educated every day of his life, same as father. He says it is all rot about 'finishing' your education. You never do. You learn more important things each day...

quotes.quote: The education of all children, from the moment that they can get along without a mother's care, shall be in state institutions.
quotes.author: Karl Marx

quotes.quote: Learning is not the accumulation of knowledge, but rather, one thing only: understanding

quotes.quote: Those who don't know must learn from those who do.

quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: We can get too easily bogged down in the academic part of homeschooling, a relatively minor part of the whole, which is to raise competent, caring, literate, happy people.
quotes.author: Diane Flynn Keith

quotes.quote: I've come to the point where I never feel the need to stop and evaluate whether or not I am happy. I'm just 'being', and without question, by default, it works.

quotes.quote: Not with whom you are born, but with whom you are bred.

quotes.quote: I am conscious of a soul-sense that lifts me above the narrow, cramping circumstances of my life. My physical limitations are forgotten- my world lies upward, the length and the breadth and the sweep of the heavens are mine!

quotes.author: Libba Bray

quotes.author: Bryant McGill

quotes.quote: I always make sure that the world will prove me right. It gives me the freedom to contradict myself.

quotes.author: Charlotte M. Mason

quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: Happiness will grow if you plant the seeds of love in the garden of hope with compassion and care.

quotes.author: Peter M. Senge

quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.author: Alan Autry

quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth

quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth

quotes.quote: You can't be a rebel without the scars that come with it. Truth is, some days scars are just as ugly as they are beautiful.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The humanities should constitute the core of any university worth the name.
quotes.author: Terry Eagleton

quotes.quote: It is very difficult to be learned; it seems as if people were worn out on the way to great thoughts, and can never enjoy them because they are too tired.
quotes.author: George Eliot,  Middlemarch

quotes.author: Nadeem Aslam,  The Wasted Vigil

quotes.author: John W. Gardner

quotes.quote: Spend your leisure time in cultivating an ear attentive to discourse, for in this way you will find that you learn with ease what others have found out with difficulty.

quotes.quote: Your personal truth is your gift to the world.
